correctness.rationale: For real depth-three leaf data with F_3(x) ≤ 1, fix folding signs ε and root mean-deviation signs s. The linear objective has coefficients ε_i(8s_i−Σs) and the maximum over s equals 64 times the folded root mean deviation. The 63 inequalities correctly encode the seven node bounds and the orthant, with eight free leaf variables and 24 nonnegative auxiliaries. For each certificate, nonnegative row multipliers give the required leaf coefficients, nonnegative auxiliary coefficients, and right-hand side at most 64, proving a bound for all real points in the sign region. Independent replay canonicalized all 4^8 colorings by subtree swaps and confirmed exact coverage by 1,540 supplied cases, and verified the multiplier identities, signs and bounds in rational arithmetic; maximum certified bound 64. The root bound also gives the four-leaf descendant bound by applying it to two identical copies of the four-leaf datum (no change in input tree BMO or folded root deviation). The two-leaf case follows from the reverse triangle inequality. Nonconstant nonnegative data give equality. Direct 16-leaf recomputation yielded F_4(x)=5 and F_4(|x|)=41/8, with only the folded root above 5.
residual_risks: Finite exact certificate for the real, equal-split, arithmetic-mean L1 seminorm; no claim about the sharp depth-four or unlimited-depth constant.
